identity.branch: repository + exact ref; tip nullable until observed
identity.chat_file: repository + full SHA + exact repository path; never an invented file_id

chat_github.runtime: host GPT with the existing GitHub app; optional native JavaScript view

rules.empty_parents_means: observed root only; unknown is null
rules.edges: explicit observed parent SHA only; never array order or compare merge-base
rules.explicit_question: feature-detected host bridge or manual copy; never direct network
rules.scope: user scope and host approvals take precedence
rules.exploration_order: enumerate inventory first; default branch to terminal bounded review first; remaining exact refs in locale-independent UTF-16 lexical order
rules.exploration_completion: whole fixed trees and unique text bodies plus model meaning/call-closure attestations; legacy60-line previews, downloads and numeric parsing alone never complete
rules.annex: path and full commit reference only; actual payload acquisition is excluded by default
rules.reading_claim: model review is an explicit evidence-linked attestation, not mechanically proven comprehension
